dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't beat yourself up over this...

dialogues.speaker: Tejima
dialogues.text: You know, that's the funny part. I can't even remember how she looks even though I loved her so much. And you'd think I would be sad.

dialogues.speaker: Tejima
dialogues.text: But for me, forgetting someone is the same as having all thoughts of them severed. I can't feel anything for them I can't even think of them.

dialogues.speaker: Tejima
dialogues.text: She's probably the one that's really sad, seeing as how I've completely forgotten about her...

dialogues.speaker: Tejima
dialogues.text: Still, thanks for retrieving those journals. Even though I still have no recollection of her, it's good to know that I was once so determined.

dialogues.speaker: Tejima
dialogues.text: I will continue to wait here for her. The me from before wouldn't have wanted to let her down...
